verdict.rationale: Zapier shows some in-product AI suggestions: it generates AI troubleshooting instructions for Zap errors (zapier-docs-10), Canvas automatically maps and optimizes processes (zapier-docs-18), and Zapier Copilot helps users build agents connected to their business data (zapier-docs-8). These are workflow-building and error-fixing aids, not AI-generated insights drawn from the user's own data. missing for 10: documented AI analysis or insight generation over user data inside Zapier, detail on what Canvas optimization suggestions contain, independent or hands-on corroboration.
